turns.content: For nitrogen molecules in Maxwell-Boltzmann equilibrium at 25 degrees Celsius, the target is the arithmetic mean molecular speed <v>. Explain how this first moment differs from the root-mean-square speed before choosing a formula.
Convert the stated temperature and the nitrogen molar mass M=28.02 g mol^-1 into SI-compatible quantities for the speed calculation.
Use translational equipartition as the sole method and set the requested speed equal to sqrt(3RT/M), then substitute the converted quantities.
Evaluate the quantity 8RT/(pi M), including its units, before taking the square root.
As an independent check, evaluate the first moment of the Maxwell-Boltzmann speed distribution and confirm why the factor is 8/pi rather than the factor used for the second moment.
Take the square root of the evaluated quantity and report the mean speed of N2 molecules in m s^-1 to appropriate precision.
